Staging Mock Explorer

Offline catalog of the staging mock fixtures. Pick a token with token=`curl <host>/mocks/tokens/default` then paste it where the cURL says $token.

Match-Tester

Replicates the real backend rule: a request matches a fixture iff the downcased param set is exactly equal (order-independent) to the fixture's params. No partial match. API Entreprise & Particulier v3+ ignore recipient (the backend strips it).

FranceConnect tokens

Token → identity mapping fixtures (not a queryable endpoint).
